title: RAGTruth 50-record faithfulness gold-alignment study
dataset: ragtruth_golden_qa_50 (dedup + 800-char contexts, assistant-curated references pending review)

coverage.coverage_note: GLM-5.3-flash improved scored rate vs deepseek-v4-flash (0.60 vs 0.66 on 10/50 sample set); 17 still timeout on long multi-passage records.

gold_alignment.conclusion: Faithfulness shows only weak negative correlation (-0.14) with RAGTruth hallucination-label count and no clear gradient across Evident/Subtle types. A single faithfulness score is NOT a reliable detector of the hallucination spans labelled by RAGTruth. This is an empirical finding that motivates multi-signal evaluation (integrity + evidence + multiple metrics) rather than trusting one score.

known_limitations: RAGTruth QA split is fully labelled; binary precision/recall is not meaningful here.
Reference answers are assistant-curated drafts, not official corpus labels.
Contexts were deduplicated and truncated to 800 chars (metadata.context_trimmed=true) to bound latency.
17 records could not be scored due to RAGAS TimeoutError even under GLM-5.3-flash + 300s.
n=33 scored samples; this is an engineering smoke study, not a statistical benchmark.
RAGTruth hallucination spans are frequently 'introduced new info' type, which faithfulness claim-verification may not reliably surface.
